# IdeaPicker

> > AI-powered startup idea generator that discovers real business opportunities by analyzing Reddit discussions and pain points across industries.

IdeaPicker helps entrepreneurs find validated startup ideas by scanning Reddit for genuine user problems and organizing them into actionable business concepts. The platform covers diverse sectors including SaaS, B2B, AI, e-commerce, and more, with each idea linked to real-world demand signals.

## Core Platform

- [IdeaPicker Homepage](https://ideapicker.io): AI-powered startup idea generator scanning Reddit for real pain points and validated business opportunities
- [Browse All Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas): Main business ideas listing page with filterable startup concepts sourced from Reddit discussions
- [Categories Directory](https://ideapicker.io/categories): Business idea categories directory organizing startup concepts by industry sectors and verticals
- [About IdeaPicker](https://ideapicker.io/about): Founder story and mission behind IdeaPicker's AI-powered business ideation platform

## Industry-Specific Ideas

- [SaaS Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/saas): SaaS business ideas with marketplace concepts and AI-powered platform opportunities
- [AI Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/artificial-intelligence): Artificial intelligence business ideas featuring NLP applications and microsaas opportunities
- [B2B Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/b2b): B2B business ideas featuring lead generation and marketing platform concepts
- [E-commerce Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/e-commerce): E-commerce ideas with 3D printing, automation, and niche product concepts
- [Marketing Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/marketing): Marketing business ideas featuring lead generation and affiliate marketing tools
- [Social Media Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/social-media): Social media startup ideas with YouTube mentorship and content scheduling tools

## Vertical Categories

- [Productivity Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/productivity): Productivity business ideas with SaaS tools and filterable startup opportunities
- [Finance Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/finance): Finance business ideas with investment platforms and tax advisory service concepts
- [Education Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/education): Education startup ideas featuring certification platforms and test preparation services
- [Real Estate Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/real-estate): Real estate startup ideas featuring property management and roommate matching solutions
- [Gaming Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/gaming): Gaming industry business ideas with game development and monetization concepts
- [API Business Ideas](https://ideapicker.io/ideas/api): API business ideas featuring Reddit scraping and integration opportunities
